feeds.title: COPD News Today
feeds.description: COPD is the third leading cause of disease-related death in the United States alone. It is also considered to be one of the most preventable diseases, as the main cause of the disease in the developed world is smoking. COPD News Today is committed to bringing the latest science and research news to those with the disease and their families.

feeds.title: The COPD Foundation Patient Blog
feeds.description: The COPD Foundation was established to improve the lives of people with COPD, bronchiectasis, and nontuberculous mycobacterial (NTM) lung disease through initiatives that expand services and speed innovations which will make treatment more effective and affordable. Learn more about COPD, common causes and symptoms, how it is diagnosed and how you can enjoy life and live for many years with COPD.

feeds.title: ScienceDaily » COPD News
feeds.description: ScienceDaily features breaking news about the latest scientific discoveries on everything from astrophysics to zoology from the world's leading universities and research organizations. Get the latest research news on COPD, including chronic bronchitis, chronic obstructive airway disease, chronic obstructive lung disease, and emphysema.

feeds.title: COPD ATHLETE Blog
feeds.description: Russell Winwood is having Asthma at 10 years old, Stroke at 36 and COPD at 45! Multiple Ironman and Marathon finisher at 52. You can lead a good life with COPD. Follow this to get the latest COPD news on COPD athlete, COPD nutrition, videos, COPD articles, and podcasts.

feeds.title: Respiratory Therapy Cave
feeds.description: The Respiratory Therapy Cave specializes in sharing facts, opinions, satire, irreverent humor, and interesting stories in respiratory therapy.

feeds.title: Oxygen Concentrator Store Blog
feeds.description: Keep up with stories and news regarding oxygen concentrators, oxygen therapy, expert reviews and respiratory-related stories from the Oxygen Concentrator Store blog.

feeds.title: LPT Medical
feeds.description: LPT Medical is a family owned and operated business. Over the years, they have quickly become one of the most trusted names in the world of oxygen therapy products offering home oxygen concentrators, portable oxygen concentrators, CPAP and BiPAP machines, and all the accessories you need to make the most of them. They not only sell portable oxygen concentrators, but also offer a host of articles, videos, and other resources to help you manage your respiratory disease. Follow the site to learn more!

feeds.title: 1st Class Medical Blog
feeds.description: 1st Class Medical is the world's largest distributor of portable oxygen concentrators! We are an authorized dealer for every major manufacturer. The POC Resource Center is your place for information regarding portable oxygen concentrators, respiratory diseases and more!

feeds.title: Melody Kool's Blog
feeds.description: Melody Kool was diagnosed with COPD, Chronic Bronchitis and possible Emphysema. It has been a life-altering change and still trying to adjust and stay healthy and active. Check out her life blog which is her writing outlet!

feeds.title: ResMed
feeds.description: At ResMed we pioneer innovative solutions that treat and keep people out of the hospital, empowering them to live healthier, higher-quality lives. Our cloud-connected medical devices transform care for people with sleep apnea, COPD and other chronic diseases. Follow this blog to find out about COPD including symptoms, diagnosis, treatment, and more.
